description: This line plot illustrates an ablation study on the HateXplain dataset, representing variations in precision, recall, and F1-score across different model variants. The categorical x-axis is labeled "Model Variants" and displays the discrete categories "Full model (Ours)", "w/o Prompt", "w/o Augmentation", "w/o Attention", and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The linear y-axis is labeled "Metric (%)", with values ranging from 58 to 66 and a tick label interval of 2. The plot features three solid lines, each utilizing circular markers to denote exact data points. The "Precision" line is purple; it begins at 65.45 for the "Full model (Ours)", declines to 61.06 at "w/o Prompt", and then steadily increases across the remaining categories, reaching 62.22 at "w/o Augmentation", 64.06 at "w/o Attention", and ending at 65.44 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The "Recall" line is blue; it starts at its highest point of 65.78, drops to 59.64 at "w/o Prompt", rises to 63.75 at "w/o Augmentation", declines to 59.17 at "w/o Attention", and ends at its lowest point of 56.82 at "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The "F1-score" line is brown; it starts at 65.56, decreases to 60.16 at "w/o Prompt", rises to 62.63 at "w/o Augmentation", drops to 59.67 at "w/o Attention", and concludes at 57.74 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation".
